title: A course pack's circuit puzzle (courses/<id>/puzzles/<name>.json)
description: A loop the player walks station by station (Keelhaven's Two Circuits: the Drydock Ring and the Lock Flight, docs/specs/ISLAND-03-keelhaven.md §5). The game owns the places, the lamps, the order and the controls; this file owns every word: the places' names, each lap's stations, their options, the reasons a wrong pick goes back, and the sections they cite. `places` binds the course's place ids to the game's (`acts`: src/game/puzzles/circuit/places.ts). docs/specs/COURSE-PACKS.md §4.

quest.description: The quest of its first lap (each lap names its own).

disabled.description: The course turns this puzzle off: its site stays as scenery and its cue does nothing.

circuit.description: Which of the game's circuits it runs: the Drydock Ring or the Lock Flight.

places.description: The course's place id → the game's place it is (`acts`, each bound once), its name on signs and in the HUD, and what it stands for in the course.

means.description: Where the place is in the app's work, shown under each station card's title (`**bold**` for the app's names).

cite.description: A key of `cites`: the section `means` comes from.

laps.description: The laps (the ring) or parts (the flight), in order. Each runs while its quest is at `step`, and ends when its last station is green.

step.description: The quest's step while the lap runs (the island's script sets it).

solved.description: The step the lap's end sets, so a reload still plays its close.

close.description: The island's script the lap's end plays at once (its NPC plays it too while the quest is at `solved`); it moves the quest on.

order.description: The work order the lap carries (on the post or the ledger).

text.description: The HUD's words by key (lamps, buttons, the live region); `{name}` is filled in by the game.

lines.description: Voice line ids (voice/lines.json) by what they're for.

cites.description: Key → a section of `chapter` (anchor and hash in lock.json): every option's and tile's `cite`.

station.description: One stop on the lap: what the player does there (`kind`), at which place (`at`).

title.description: What the step is, in the course's words (the HUD's heading).

text.description: What happens (a `watch` demo's caption, or the station's readout).

line.description: A voice line played as the station opens.

image.description: A course image (a chapter's images) shown in the spyglass at the station.

action.description: A `watch` station's one thing to do (its button's label), shown with `prompt`; the demo plays once it's done.

again.description: A `sound` station: what a plank tapped twice says.

options.description: A `choose` or `seal` station's options: at least one right; every other goes back with its reason.

tiles.description: A `tiles` station's claims: the ones that stick make the summary.

lamps.description: A `gate` station's lamps, in order: all but the last light by themselves; the last is the player's seal.

hints.description: Wingman's three hint tiers (a question, the reason, the choice): text, not voice.

cite.description: A key of `cites`: the section this station teaches.

result.description: What the player sees when they pick it.

reason.description: A wrong pick: why, in the course's words.

backTo.description: A wrong pick: the key of the place the hull goes back to.

cite.description: A wrong pick: the key of `cites` its reason comes from.

line.description: A voice line played when it's picked.
